---
title: References
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElementCount:
        - selectors: ['meta[name="citation_reference"]', '.csl-entry[id^="ref-"]']
          counts: [2, 2]
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_author=Alice Smith;"]', 'meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_author=Bob Jones;"]']
        - ['meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_author=Carol Brown;"]']
---

The book bibliography is assembled after each page renders, from the citations of every chapter.
This page cites nothing itself, yet its Google Scholar metadata should list the works shown below: `cited` from the preface and `included` from the chapter, but not the unused entry of the `.bib` file.

::: {#refs}
:::
